description: This file defines an Angular service for handling two-factor authentication (2FA) operations, including retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting 2FA settings and configurations via HTTP requests.

classes.name: TwoFactorAuthenticationService
classes.description: Angular service providing methods to manage two-factor authentication settings and configurations.

methods.name: getTwoFaSettings
methods.description: Fetches current 2FA settings from the server.

methods.name: saveTwoFaSettings
methods.description: Saves updated 2FA settings to the server.

methods.name: generateTwoFaAccountConfig
methods.description: Generates a new 2FA account configuration for a specified provider.

methods.name: updateTwoFaAccountConfig
methods.description: Updates the 2FA account configuration, setting whether it is used by default.

methods.name: submitTwoFaAccountConfig
methods.description: Submits the 2FA account configuration for processing.

methods.name: verifyAndSaveTwoFaAccountConfig
methods.description: Verifies and saves the 2FA account configuration with an optional verification code.

methods.name: deleteTwoFaAccountConfig
methods.description: Deletes a 2FA account configuration for a specified provider.

methods.name: requestTwoFaVerificationCodeSend
methods.description: Requests sending a verification code for 2FA.
